title: Interactive Widgets
description: Create clickable buttons, draggable sliders, toggle switches, and branching dialogue choices.

blocks.content: Interactive widgets let players click buttons, drag sliders, flip toggle switches, and select dialogue choices using mouse or touch input.

items.title: Responsive Buttons
items.desc: Scale buttons smoothly on hover and press while firing click events for scene navigation or menu actions.

items.title: Sliders & Toggle Switches
items.desc: Drag slider handles to adjust audio channels or flip animated toggle switches for settings menus.

items.title: Dialogue & Choice Menus
items.desc: Stream typewriter dialogue with character portraits and present interactive branching choice buttons.

blocks.content: Prepare a screen-space UI layer and attach visual and interaction components to your widget entities.

rows: [Scene Hierarchy](interface/scene_hierarchy)
UI Layer
Locks widget entities to the screen by setting **Parallax X** and **Parallax Y** to **0**.
[Sprite Renderer](components/renderers/sprite_renderer) or [Shape Renderer](components/renderers/shape_renderer)
Buttons, Tracks & Knobs
Renders the visual bounds used for mouse raycast hit-testing and visual state changes.
[Text Renderer](components/renderers/text_renderer)
Labels & Dialogue Box
Displays button captions, slider percentages, and typewriter dialogue strings.
[Script Controller](components/script_controller)
UI Manager or Widget

Runs [Button Scale Effect](node_library/game_animation#node-uiButtonScaleEffect), [Atomic Slider](node_library/helper_tool#node-atomicSlider), or [Switch Button Shape](node_library/helper_tool#node-switchButtonShape).

blocks.content: Follow these steps to build an animated menu button, a draggable slider, and a toggle switch on a UI layer.

items: In the [Scene Hierarchy](interface/scene_hierarchy), create a dedicated **UI** layer above your gameplay layers and set its **Parallax X** and **Parallax Y** to **0**.

Create a button entity on the **UI** layer with a [Sprite Renderer](components/renderers/sprite_renderer) or [Shape Renderer](components/renderers/shape_renderer) component, and attach a child [Text Renderer](components/renderers/text_renderer) label.

Open the UI [Logic Graph](visual_scripting/graph_concepts), add [On Tick](node_library/game_lifecycle#node-eventTick), and connect it to [Button Scale Effect](node_library/game_animation#node-uiButtonScaleEffect) targeting the button entity.
Connect the **On Click** output of **Button Scale Effect** to [Change Scene](node_library/game_lifecycle#node-changeScene) or your menu action logic.

To add a value slider, create a horizontal bar entity and a knob child entity, then wire **On Tick** into [Atomic Slider](node_library/helper_tool#node-atomicSlider) with **Bar Entity** and **Handler Entity** assigned.

To add a settings toggle, create a track shape and a knob shape, then wire [Switch Button Shape](node_library/helper_tool#node-switchButtonShape) to animate the knob position and track color when clicked.

blocks.content: Adjust these parameters on [Button Scale Effect](node_library/game_animation#node-uiButtonScaleEffect), [Atomic Slider](node_library/helper_tool#node-atomicSlider), and [Switch Button Shape](node_library/helper_tool#node-switchButtonShape) to refine widget responsiveness.

rows: **Scale Normal / Hover / Pressed**
Target scale multipliers applied to the button when idle, hovered by the cursor, or held down.
**Lerp Speed**
Smoothing factor for button scale transitions each frame; higher values snap faster.
**Use Raycast**
true
Ensures only the topmost visible UI entity under the cursor receives the hover or click event.
**Min / Max / Step**
Defines the numeric range and rounding increment output by **Atomic Slider** as the user drags the handle.
**Slide Distance**
Horizontal distance in pixels that the toggle knob travels from the center of the track when switched on or off.
**Duration**
Transition time in seconds for the toggle switch knob slide and color interpolation.

blocks.content: Combine interaction nodes to build multi-channel audio mixers, custom sprite switches, and visual novel dialogue systems.

rows: **Multi-Channel Audio Mixer**

Use [Volume Slider Manager](node_library/helper_tool#node-volumeSliderManager) and pass a map of **master**, **vocal**, **sfx**, and **background** bar, handler, and text indicator entities to control all audio buses in one node.
**Sprite-Based Toggle Switch**
Replace shape colors with custom textures using [Switch Button Image](node_library/helper_tool#node-switchButtonImage) to swap track and knob sprites between on and off states.
**Visual Novel Dialogue & Choices**

Wire [Dialogue Runner](node_library/helper_tool#node-vnDialogueRunner) to stream JSON dialogue lines with character portraits, then trigger [Choice Presenter](node_library/helper_tool#node-vnChoicePresenter) to display branching buttons.
**Modal Popup Input Locking**
Call [Freeze Layer Input](node_library/input_controls#node-freezeLayerInput) when opening a pause or confirmation popup so clicks do not pass through to underlying gameplay or menu layers.
Clicking a UI button also triggers an entity or button behind it

Enable **Use Raycast** on [Button Scale Effect](node_library/game_animation#node-uiButtonScaleEffect) or [Entity Mouse Event](node_library/input_controls#node-mouseEntityInteract), or lock lower layers with [Freeze Layer Input](node_library/input_controls#node-freezeLayerInput).
Buttons and sliders drift off screen when the camera moves
Open the [Scene Hierarchy](interface/scene_hierarchy) layer settings and set the UI layer's **Parallax X** and **Parallax Y** to **0**.
[Atomic Slider](node_library/helper_tool#node-atomicSlider) knob moves beyond the bar edges

Ensure the **Bar Entity** has a [Sprite Renderer](components/renderers/sprite_renderer) or [Shape Renderer](components/renderers/shape_renderer) with an explicit **Width** greater than zero so the slider can calculate drag bounds.
Hover and click detection feels offset from the visible button graphic
Check that the button entity's pivot is centered (**0.5, 0.5**) or add a [Multi Collider](components/multi_collider) and enable **Use Collider Bounds** on **Entity Mouse Event**.
